summary: {LEVEL} is held from before the alarm, not read from the forecasts. The drift latch has been set since {LATCHED} after a downward breach, because attendances fell to {F1} from {F2}. All forecasts are untrusted until a person approves a latch reset, so look at the released weeks and do not plan on a forecast.
expected_range: No forecast range can be trusted while the drift latch is set. Use the released weeks of attendances as the guide.
model_agreement: All forecasts are untrusted while the drift latch is set, so the models' agreement or disagreement is not a guide and none is ranked above another. The back-test error in this brief is historical and does not restore trust in the forecasts while the latch is set.
watch_points: Check the released weeks of attendances up to {ORIGIN} and compare them with the current rota.
Review staffing and leave using released actuals and current operational information; do not base changes on the untrusted forecasts.

Ask for the latch to be reviewed as more weeks are released; a person approves a latch reset once the documented reset criteria are met, not merely after a further release. Note Good Friday in the rota check.
